🛑 Requirement: Exercise the debug-only tests in CI

This build constraint excludes the override and invalid-input tests from the existing CI invocation, which uses only the integration tag (.github/workflows/go.yml:32). The build step also omits ghdebug, so this workflow does not compile or test the enabled implementation. Add a separate ghdebug-tagged test invocation covering internal/debug and the factory override tests, while retaining the regular run to cover the disabled implementation.

Not changing this one. The `ghdebug` build is a developer tool for testing token expiry, used rarely, and it never ships. Running a second tagged test pass on every OS in the matrix is more CI cost than it is worth for that. The production side is already covered by the regular run: release builds compile `config_disabled.go`, and `TestConfigIgnoresEnvironment` asserts that `Config()` returns no overrides even when the `GH_INTERNAL_*` variables are set. If the enabled implementation breaks, it shows up as soon as someone runs `make debug` or the e2e scripts, which only affects whoever is building the debug binary.
